premises: Exact rank three A=UMU^T with U^TU=I_3 and |lambda_j(M)|>=1.
Null-Rayleigh physical hub u_0=sqrt(h)r with r^TMr=0.
Original coordinates remain the only independent source variables.
Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov k=2 product marginal density cap 2.

new_claims.statement: If leaves split into original-coordinate banks L,R with G_R=Gram(y_R,z_R)>0 and t_R in span(y_R,z_R), then Q has a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf <= 6*2^(2/3) h^(-1/3)D^(-1/3)(det G_R)^(-1/3).
delta_R^2 det G_R = sum_{i<j<k in R} det(u_i,u_j,u_k)^2, where delta_R=dist(t_R,span(y_R,z_R)).
In the diffuse collar tau_i<1/4, if longitudinal leakage is supported on at most three leaves, then ||p_Q||inf<24 h^(-1/3)D^(-1/3); in the existing ultra-collar this is <24.002, with continuity.
For every leaf split I,J, S^2 Z_2 = hD^2||y_J||^2 det G_I det Gram(P_{y_J^perp}t_J,P_{y_J^perp}z_J) <= hD^2(1-h). This is a proof-architecture barrier, not a QFORM counterexample.

partner_result_applied.application: Partner exact {-1,1,1} near-coloop family gets ||p_Qrho||inf<9.575 with continuity. Orthogonally row-mixing its pure longitudinal leaf with one e2/8 leaf creates same-source longitudinal/transverse contamination and is still paid by the new theorem with ||p_Q||inf<9.625.
